title: baccharis decussata subsp. jelskii
intro: Baccharis decussata subsp. jelskii, commonly known as Andean buttonbush or Andean groundsel, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Baccharis decussata subsp. jelskii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
